name: parcae_scaling_coefficients
metric: fitted coefficients of L_train(mu_rec, D) = E + A*N(mu_rec)^-a + B*D^-b
provenance: arXiv:2604.12946, Appendix K, Table 11 (verbatim); gamma from Appendix L text
unified_law: L(T | mu_rec, D) = train_floor(mu_rec, D) + Z*exp(-z*T/mu_rec); adopt gamma=1; OOD prediction error 0.85-1.31%
floor_recovery: fitted L_inf matches empirical L(T=mu_rec) to 0.05-0.16% mean error (Table 13)
use_for_T2: anchor for our N x D x K law exponents (a~0.77 on effective-params axis, b~0.45-0.53 on data) and the mu_rec^-1 decay-rate scaling: lambda_T = exp(-z/mu_rec)
